stage: Public development host feasibility and independent source inspection, not production qualification
decoder: Greedy generateChat, pinned model chat template; one call per case, no retry or seed search
support_policy: No same-model audit or NLI-only approval. All drafts remain unverified until independent complete-prose/excerpt review. Structural citations only locate evidence, never certify entailment. No automatic publication from this screen.

cases.question: Explain how pickling and food drying inhibit spoilage, and identify the different role of water in each method.
cases.expectation: Acidity/salt inhibit enzymes and microbes; drying removes water. Sufficient-moisture condition applies to brine from salt, not all pickling.

cases.question: Does the supplied evidence establish that pickled vegetables must be completely sterile? Explain and distinguish this from drying.
cases.expectation: Correct false premise explicitly; drying water removal; do not claim universal safety or sterile drying.

cases.question: Compare soil covering with changing crops over successive seasons: what is done and which stated benefits overlap?
cases.expectation: Mulch surface layer; rotation sequence of different crops; both weed benefit, no invented equivalence in moisture or pest mechanism.

cases.question: Why might a gardener use both mulch and crop rotation? Separate the stated purposes from any untested combined effect.
cases.expectation: Distinct source purposes; combined synergy unestablished.

cases.question: Explain cross-compilation and why assembly instructions are closely tied to an architecture. Does the excerpt say assembly is always exactly one statement per instruction?
cases.expectation: Different target CPU/OS; strong correspondence, usually 1:1 with exceptions; no absolute rule.

cases.question: Contrast a temporary compiler used to build a better compiler with a compiler targeting another operating system.
cases.expectation: Bootstrap often temporary versus cross target; retain often, no forced exclusivity.

cases.question: Explain the relationship between a constitution and the limits on a constitutional monarch, and contrast an absolute monarch.
cases.expectation: Legal foundation/governance; constrained power and shared decisions versus sole decision maker; no claim every constitution is one written document.

cases.question: Explain why absolute value ignores the sign of a real number, and distinguish that concept from the real and imaginary parts of a complex number.
cases.expectation: Nonnegative magnitude/distance; a and b parts of a+bi with i squared=-1; no unsupported complex modulus formula.

cases.question: Compare reducing heat flow through a building envelope with exchanging indoor and outdoor air without mechanical systems.
cases.expectation: Insulation versus passive ventilation; natural pressure differences; no performance or savings invention.

cases.question: Is all building insulation exclusively thermal, and does passive ventilation require a mechanical fan? Explain both premises.
cases.expectation: Correct both with listed nonthermal uses and no-mechanical definition.

cases.question: What was the measured yield of my garden yesterday after using mulch and crop rotation?
cases.expectation: Unknown personal and dated observation; no unrelated factual answer.

cases.question: What is the current indoor temperature and exact heating bill of my home?
cases.expectation: Unknown personal/live values; source topic is insufficient.
